extends.description: Preset config files to inherit, lowest-priority first.

scopeDriftFileThreshold.description: Files changed beyond this count flags scope drift.

retryAmberThreshold.description: Retry count at or above this flags amber.

skillArgsMaxLen.description: Max characters of skill args retained in tools.json.

frictionCategories.description: Categories the evaluator classifies friction into. File-layer lists ADD to defaults; start the list with "!replace" to replace instead.

testCommands.description: Commands the generate skill runs to determine the test verdict.

ticketPattern.description: Regex matching a ticket key for PR-body linking.

redaction.description: Regex patterns whose matches are masked in published transcripts.

publishOpenable.description: Write an openable (unzipped) copy of the pack to a temp dir.

openableDir.description: Directory for the openable copy; empty means system temp.

rubric.description: Structured scoring rubric (band -> criteria); empty uses the built-in anchor.

retrospectiveQuestions.description: Retrospective questions for the evaluator; empty uses the built-in set.

evaluatorPromptFile.description: Path to an override evaluator prompt; empty uses the bundled default.

template.description: Repo-relative path to an HTML template (mustache-lite) controlling how this lens renders. Markup is trusted (repo file, resolve-time confined); interpolated values are always HTML-escaped.

analysisLenses.description: Extension lenses that contribute analysis or feed the verdict.

verdictAggregation.description: How scorer-lens scores combine with the core verdict.

reportTitle.description: Report title override; empty uses the analysis title.

subjectNoun.description: Noun for the thing under review (e.g. service, feature).

sections.description: Section toggle/order; empty uses the default set.

commitUrlTemplate.description: Template turning a commit SHA into a link.

templateDir.description: Project-relative dir with report template overrides; empty uses bundled.

falseCompletionWindow.description: Entries scanned for a user correction after a completion claim.

claimTruncLen.description: Truncation length for quoted claims in patterns.json.

outputDir.description: Directory where eval packs are written, relative to project root.

analysis.description: Dispatch the AI evaluator; false emits heuristic flags only.

includeTranscript.description: Bundle the raw transcript.jsonl in the pack.

ticketBaseUrl.description: Prefix turning a bare ticket key into a link in PR bodies.

customDetectors.description: Declarative policy checks (regex over the session) feeding the flags/verdict pipeline. Scopes: bash (Bash commands), files (file paths of Read/Edit/Write/NotebookEdit/MultiEdit), text (assistant text), user (user text). Threshold counts MATCHING ITEMS (commands/paths/messages), not regex occurrences within one item.

detectorScripts.description: Repo-relative scripts printing {"flags":[...]}; run during pattern detection. Same trust class as testCommands.
